text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is German.
Russian(x) ::: x is Russian.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
MemberOf(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
PrussianStateParliament ::: the Prussian State Parliament.
NaziReichstag ::: the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
German(heinrichSchmidt) ∧ Politician(heinrichSchmidt) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was a German politician.
MemberOf(heinrichSchmidt, PrussianStateParliament) ∧ MemberOf(heinrichSchmidt, NaziReichstag) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
German(heinrichSchmidt) ∨ Russian(heinrichSchmidt) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was German or Russian or both.
